description: Polymarket markets, by `view`. `trending` (default): top prediction-market events ranked by 24h volume. Returns market title, slug, category, current Yes/No mid quotes, 24h volume, and end_date. Filter by category (Crypto | Sports | Politics | Pop-Culture | Tech | all). Use for 'what's hot on Polymarket' or 'top crypto prediction markets'. `search`: the recorded markets whose slug contains `query` (case-insensitive), optionally only active or only closed ones, newest end_date first, paged with `limit` and `offset`; rows {active, closed, condition_id, end_date (epoch), neg_risk, slug, tick_size, token_ids}, `active` / `closed` derived from the on-chain resolution and Polymarket's own flag (a filter on them is the slower read). `market`: one market by `condition_id` in that row shape, a list of 0 or 1 rows, from the recorded markets or else Polymarket's full catalogue (`source` says which; an unknown id is `[]`). Same data as GET /v1/polymarket/markets and /markets/{condition_id}.

active.description: `search` only: true = only active markets, false = only closed ones; omit for all. Not together with `closed`.

closed.description: `search` only: the complement of `active` (true = only closed). Not together with `active`.

condition_id.description: `market` only, required there: the 0x-prefixed condition id.

limit.description: Max markets: `trending` default 10, max 30; `search` default 50, max 100 (a larger value is clamped).

offset.description: `search` only: rows to skip, 0 to 10000 (default 0); above 10000 is refused.

query.description: `search` only: case-insensitive substring of the market slug.

view.description: `trending` (default): top by 24h volume; `search`: filter the recorded markets; `market`: one market by condition_id.
